thread:
morgan: heads up — partner log ingestion contains multiple lines that look like base64 blobs. one of them decodes to KMS ciphertext header. quarantined the bucket and alerted partner. assigning incident id INC-2026-045 :rotating_light:
security-bot: Alert INC-2026-045 detected by log-scan: potential credential leakage in partner/gcs-staging. severity: medium. auto-quarantine applied.
samir: thanks. do we know which secrets are affected? vault paths, service accounts, or just encrypted blobs? :eyes:
morgan: looks like wrapped vault ciphertext blobs (transit-wrapped). i can share a sample in DMs, but initial grep shows references to vault/transit/crypto-key and a few svcacc emails.
jin: ok plan proposal — short checklist so we can act fast:
  1) confirm affected vault paths and list ciphertext IDs (morgan)
  2) rotate KMS wrapping key (create new key version) — samir/jin
  3) rewrap existing ciphertexts in Vault using new KMS key (vault rewrap job) — ops-oncall
  4) rotate any exposed service-account keys and block old keys (samir)
  5) confirm RBAC: ensure partner ingestion role limited to read-only and remove any broad perms (morgan + sec)
  6) enable audit logging for vault/transit and KMS and export to secure bucket (jin)
  7) post-rotation verification: attempt decrypts with old key (should fail) and new key (should succeed)

samir: sounds good. timeline? i can create new KMS key version in ~15m but need ops to run rewrap job. we should pick a 1h maintenance window and notify partner + oncall.
ops-oncall: i can run the rewrap job once key version is created. prefer window: 2026-05-15 03:00-04:00 UTC to minimize prod impact. will prepare runbook.
morgan: 03:00-04:00 UTC works for me. i'll own the artifact list (ciphertext ids + vault paths).
jin: sample commands for KMS version and rewrap (for ops notes):
  - create new key version:
    gcloud kms keys versions create --key="wrap-key" --keyring="redwood-keys" --location="us-central1"
  - list versions:
    gcloud kms keys versions list --key="wrap-key" --location="us-central1" --keyring="redwood-keys"
  - rewrap using vault (example):
    # iterate ciphertext ids, call Vault rewrap API
    for id in $(cat ciphertext_ids.txt); do
      curl -s -X POST "$VAULT_ADDR/v1/sys/transit/rewrap/$id" -H "X-Vault-Token: $VAULT_TOKEN" -d '{"key": "wrap-key"}';
    done

morgan: i'll export ciphertext_ids.txt to the secure ops bucket and share link in the runbook.
samir: after rewrap we should rotate any service-account keys that appear in the logs. commands:
  gcloud iam service-accounts keys create new-key.json --iam-account=svc-ingest@redwood-infra.iam.gserviceaccount.com
  gcloud iam service-accounts keys delete OLD_KEY_ID --iam-account=...

jin: RBAC change note — temporarily restrict partner ingestion role to a scoped IAM binding and add condition on resource name until they confirm fix. i'll prepare terraform diff.
security-bot: Audit change: enabling detailed vault/transit audit logs for 90 days and forwarding KMS logs to secure-sys-logs bucket. Logging runbook: https://intranet.redwood/ops/runbooks/rewrap-rotation (internal) :lock:
morgan: vuln triage note — mark this CWE as possible information exposure, tag jira SEC-7123, assign to sec triage. will attach sample artifact.
ops-oncall: i'll stand by in #eng-oncall during the window and will post progress updates. please ack who will run post-verify checks.
samir: i'll run svc-account rotations and smoke tests against staging consumers.
jin: i'll validate audit trails and check for any anomalous decrypts after rewrap. also will run a quick RBAC diff post-change.
morgan: ok owners nailed. before we execute: quick prechecks list:
  - confirm partner has rotated their ingest creds (morgan)
  - ensure backups of current ciphertexts stored in quarantine bucket (ops-oncall)
  - notify infra teams and set alert suppressions for expected failures during rotation (samir)

samir: noted. i'll open a calendar event and ping partner. tagging @jin for terraform review and @ops-oncall for runbook.
morgan: thanks — will update INC-2026-045 with timeline and attach artifacts. :thumbsup:
security-bot: Incident INC-2026-045 updated: owners assigned (morgan, samir, jin, ops-oncall). Next update due in 30m.
